report-card-generator.workedExample: Take five subjects, each out of 100: Hindi 82, English 76, Mathematics 91, Science 68, Social Science 73. Total obtained = 82 + 76 + 91 + 68 + 73 = 390. Total maximum = 500. Percentage = (390 / 500) x 100 = 78.0%. On the A+–F scale, 78% falls in the 70–79 band, so the grade is B+. On the division scale, 78% is above 60, so the division is First Division. Since 78% is above 33, the result is Pass.
